stage_note: Design: proxyForwardedHeaders.ts drops all client-address headers and sets one trusted X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP; API client_address trusts XFF only from loopback, IPv6 keyed per /64. RBAC: _STEWARD_WRITE = require_roles(ADMIN, STEWARD) on every steward write; job create/process/cancel/retry admit planner at the route then require_import_template_role per template. Web: shared stewardAccess helper + StewardWriteGate (notice + disabled fieldset) on steward pages; exceptions inbox hides delete/clear.
